value.answer: Tomorrow in Toronto should be warm, around 25°C. Environment Canada has a mix of sun and cloud, with a 40% chance of showers and a risk of thunderstorms late in the afternoon. It'll be fairly windy, southwest at 20 km/h with gusts to 40. Tuesday night drops to a low of 15°C, with showers and a chance of thunder in the evening.
